metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows simple, straightforward exercises to help you stay active and fit after 55 years young.

These exercises will focus on improving balance, strength and flexibility. Make sure to go through them all and use what works best for you.

Watch now and stay fit and active after 55!

0:00 Intro
0:39 Flexibility
4:39 Balance
